title: dashboard: no save or publish gate judges a compare widget's date key against the dataset's declared dimensions
body:
domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jUg7BKfRBcTPyMxbLh

Filing gate ③: area-directed (area S2 of seat domain:server#5). Finding M2 (d) of the L2 contract review 6908009392 on PR #34198 (card #34005).

## Today

A dashboard's date range names an object FIELD (`dateRange.field`, default `created_at`), judged against the object by `dashboard-filter-field-unknown`, not against the dataset's declared `dimensions`. A compare widget lowers that date key into `timeDimensions`. With PR #34198 a dataset query refuses an undeclared member, so a dashboard whose date field is not also the NAME of a declared dimension is refused at render. No gate sees it first: `report-date-range-dimension-unknown` judges reports only, no lint rule reads a widget's `compareTo`, and the publish build probe asks each widget's measures with no window. The shipped stacks name the dimension after the field, so the authored census found none; a runtime-saved or third-party dashboard has no such guarantee.

## Ask

Refuse at save and at publish a dashboard compare widget whose effective date key (its `compareTo.dimension`, else the dashboard date-range field) is not a declared dimension of the widget's dataset, with the remedy in the message (declare a date dimension named as the date-range field, or set `compareTo.dimension` to a declared one). Pin the refused and the served case. Re-run the authored census and state its count.

Blocked-by: #34198 (the runtime rule this gate mirrors).

Reader: domain:server (lint + build probes). Size S.
